texts.about_this_item: Monge BWild Grain Free Formula Large Breed All Life Stage Cat Buffalo with Potatoes and Lentils is a complete, balanced grain-free food using alternative carbohydrate sources (legumes) and high quality ingredients such as buffalo meat. Enriched with XOS and MOS prebiotics, omega-3 fatty acids for coat shine, and taurine for cardiac function. The extra-large cylinder-shaped kibble encourages chewing for oral hygiene. Suitable for large breed cats of all life stages. No added dyes or artificial preservatives.
texts.ingredient_information: Buffalo meat (dried 38%, fresh 15%), potatoes (15%), animal fat (13%) (chicken oil purified 99.5%), lentils (8%), potato protein, fish oil (salmon oil purified at 99.5%), hydrolysed animal proteins, dried beet pulp, brewers' yeast, minerals, mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS 1%), xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spiruline (0.1%) glucosamine (0.057%), chondroitin sulphate (0.04%).
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and living conditions of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times.
